task: Retrospect this assistant's actual tool use and unnecessary repetition. Judge only each claim/evidence relation; do not authorize actions or certify completion.

checks.source: Transcript: first SmartTube debug investigation, functions.exec rg output
checks.claim: The initial search scope was unnecessarily broad for locating a log-export UI.
checks.evidence: Command searched common smarttubetv MediaServiceCore with "export.*log|log.*export|save.*log|share.*log|dump.*log|debug.*log|collect.*log|send.*log|日志|导出" without source-extension filters. Result: "Warning: truncated output (original token count: 213260)"; a match in MediaServiceCore/youtubeapi/src/test/resources/video_info/get_video_info_with_ads.orig printed a long encoded player response.

checks.source: Transcript: GitHub README fetch calls after user requested upstream inspection
checks.claim: The repeated README retrievals added avoidable network calls; the first response could have been retained and filtered locally.
checks.evidence: README.md fetched once in full; fetched again only to print matches from /log|debug|crash|device|version/gi; fetched a third time to print line-context around /logcat|debug|logging/i. No intervening change to the target ref was requested.

checks.claim: The four initial empty searches are conclusive evidence that SmartTube has no official logging workflow.
checks.evidence: All four query strings included repository_name="yuliskov/SmartTube" inside the query while also passing repository_name separately. All returned results: []. Subsequent REST issue searches found logcat reports and maintainer testing-build comments.

checks.source: Transcript: Round 138 and literal CRLF repair calls
checks.claim: Running validation concurrently with the mutation can validate the old state rather than the delivered edit.
checks.evidence: Promise.allSettled ran a write to docs/development/2026-09-20.md beside git diff --check; the next invocation ran a plan CRLF-repair write beside git diff --numstat and git diff --check. The operations targeted the same documents.

checks.source: Transcript: acceptance-matrix replacement and completion commentary
checks.claim: The reported acceptance-matrix change was not established by the successful replacement command.
checks.evidence: PowerShell $s.Replace searched a single-line unbolded "Release/signing: debug and release variants..." string. Actual file had "4. **Release/signing**:" and wrapped lines. Replace has no missing-match assertion. Round 138 nevertheless states "The acceptance matrix now says automated gates pass while release quality remains unverified."

checks.source: Transcript: first plan Jev batch rows t06/t10/next
checks.claim: That Jev batch independently verified the implementation and established that no useful local work remained.
checks.evidence: Evidence for t06/t10 was prose from the status table and test-name listings, not source/test outputs. next asked whether local code expansion was highest-value using a list of external blockers. Tool result explicitly lists not_checked: evidence authenticity/freshness, code correctness, overall task completion. Later review identified stale log summaries and incomplete lint evidence.

checks.source: Transcript: export request followed by async question
checks.claim: Clarifying whether the user wanted subtitles, diagnostic logs, or both was necessary to avoid implementing the wrong export.
checks.evidence: Discussion concerned log export, then user said 一键导出字幕. Assistant first searched subtitle structures and storage. Later asked three-way export-content question; user explicitly answered 两者都要：分别提供日志和字幕导出按钮.
